card.title: Secure the Endorsement
card.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

mechanism: A seeks a public or widely copied endorsement that can defend the rota against later blame.
confusable: Unlike seeking private reassurance, A must make support visible to people who could challenge the decision.
comparison: D52-a expands an email audience; D52-b makes initials publicly identifiable.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
